name: Sun Cleric: Sunsworn's auto attack mana is logged as Energize 3% 504619, threat-free, 3% of maximum mana
contract: Sunsworn 802935 reads 'auto attacks now have a $h% chance to restore $504619s1% of your maximum mana'; 802935
SPELL_ATTR1_NO_THREAT), its only DBC incoming link. Live combat logs credit 2922 player energize events to 504619
(12 logs, 2026-07-12..2026-08-23). The script gave the right amount but sent it through Mana()'s default source
504877 'Vow of Grace' (AttributesEx 0), so the log named Vow of Grace and Unit::EnergizeBySpell forwarded 0.5
threat per point to every creature the cleric threatens. Both clerics swing one Scimitar 2027 (the class file
weapon) at their own dummy at level 60; only the treatment knows Sunsworn. The 10% roll is per swing: three
procs within 300 s of 2300 ms swings (about 130 trials) fail to arrive with probability about 1.3e-4. Each event
mana (floored), none may be logged as 504877, the control logs none, and the treatment's threat per melee damage
must equal the control's within 0.5%; 504877's threat would add at least 1% (checked by the SETUP bound).
